name: STA130H1 — Deductive Derivation (Hypothesis Testing and p-values)
description: H₀ (no effect) vs H₁ (effect). Assume H₀ true, calculate p = P(data as extreme or more | H₀). If p < α (usually 0.05), REJECT H₀.

steps.template_en: H₀ (no effect) vs H₁ (effect). Assume H₀ true, calculate p = P(data as extreme or more | H₀). If p < α (usually 0.05), REJECT H₀.
steps.template_zh: H₀(无效应)vs H₁(有效应)。假设H₀真，计算p=P(数据同样或更极端|H₀)。若p<α(通常0.05)，拒绝H₀。

steps.template_en: Coin fairness: 100 flips, 65 heads. H₀: p=0.5. X~Bin(100,0.5). P(X≥65 or X≤35)=0.0035. p<0.05, reject H₀. Evidence the coin is biased.
steps.template_zh: 硬币公平性：100次，65次正面。H₀:p=0.5。p<0.05，拒绝H₀。硬币有偏的证据。

steps.template_en: p-value MISINTERPRETATIONS: (1) NOT P(H₀ true). (2) NOT P(result by chance). (3) NOT P(Type I error). p = P(data|H₀). P(H₀|data) needs BAYES.
steps.template_zh: p值误解：(1)不是P(H₀真)。(2)不是P(结果偶然)。(3)不是P(I类错)。p=P(数据|H₀)。P(H₀|数据)需贝叶斯。

steps.template_en: Type I: reject true H₀ (α). Type II: fail to reject false H₀ (β). Power = 1-β = P(reject|H₁ true). Power depends on: effect size, n, α, variability. More n → more power.
steps.template_zh: I类：拒绝真H₀。II类：未能拒绝假H₀。功效=1-β=P(拒绝|H₁真)。取决于效应量、n、α、变异性。

steps.template_en: 'p<0.05' is CONVENTION, not truth. Problems: p-hacking, multiple comparisons (20 tests → 1 significant by chance). Solutions: pre-registration, Bonferroni, effect sizes, CIs.
steps.template_zh: 'p<0.05'是惯例，不是真理。问题：p操纵、多重比较。解决：预先注册、Bonferroni、效应量、CI。

steps.template_en: ASA statement (2016): 'By itself, a p-value does not provide a good measure of evidence.' Better: effect sizes, CIs, Bayes factors. Statistical significance ≠ practical significance.
steps.template_zh: ASA声明(2016)：'p值本身不提供良好证据度量。'更好：效应量、CI、贝叶斯因子。统计显著性≠实际显著性。
